text:
maria: quick thought — can we add a small per-model "burst forecast" sparkline on the econ card? 60m history + 10m forecast, include token-cost and cache-savings stacked. would help SREs and PMs spot bill spikes
kevin: sg. question: accurate backend agg vs sampled estimate? full-window agg is expensive.
jamal: sampling + weighted extrapolation is the pragmatic approach. we already sample traces at 1% in ingest. need to preserve sample_weight through the window agg.
sara: UX: if it's sampled we must surface sample_rate + confidence band, don't show raw numbers as absolute. tiny info icon should explain method. :information_source:
priya: also watch out for cache hit attribution. some sidecars tag hits as "kv-cache" and others as "prefetch" — unify tags first or savings will be noisy.
maria: minimal API shape idea (proto):
```
GET /api/console/v1/models/costs?model=gpt-xx&window=60m&granularity=1m&sample_rate=0.01
Response: timestamps[], token_cost[], cache_savings[], sample_rate=0.01, confidence_low[], confidence_high[]
```
kevin: fine on shape. we should also return a boolean 'is_estimated' and raw_sample_n to qualify tiny buckets.
jamal: impl note: ingest needs to attach sample_weight + cache_tag to each event. aggregator does weighted sums per-minute and can compute simple bootstrap CIs (or asymptotic var). cheap and good enough.
sara: rollout path: feature-flag + alpha tenants. console toggle "show estimated cost" default off. show badge "estimated" when true.
priya: multi-model chains caveat: tokens generated by model B that were produced as input to model C — where do we attribute cost? typical choice: attribute created tokens to the generating model and input tokens to the route. need doc.
maria: agree. also need to avoid double crediting cache savings when prefetch is applied at router + sidecar.
ops-bot: Deploy scheduled: telemetry/ingest-preserve-sample-weight @ 2024-09-10T02:00Z — will touch /ingest/agg pipeline
kevin: we should backfill 7 days for the new series to keep charts smooth. small batch job ok?
jamal: backfill should be doable but expensive if we re-run full windows; I'd propose storing sampled series and extrapolating historical sparklines instead of full re-agg. cheaper.
sara: UX team happy to build a placeholder widget with mocked data. will want sample_rate toggles to simulate behavior.
maria: i'll create a tracking ticket and attach a mock CSV.
kevin: i'll own the backend endpoint and flag gating. tagging @sara @jamal @priya for reviews.
priya: I'll audit cache tags and send a normalization PR.
maria: thanks all — will follow up with the ticket link and mock data. :rocket:
